  • Source - an infected person’s ,when they cough, sneeze, speak, sing or breathe.

  • droplets of an infected person (generated through coughing and sneezing), and
  • touching surfaces contaminated with the virus. The COVID-19 virus may survive on
  • surfaces for several hours, but simple disinfectants can kill it.(2)
  • Control - The best way to prevent and slow down transmission is to be well informed

  • infection by staying at least 1 metre apart from others, wearing a properly fitted
  • mask, and washing your hands or using an alcohol-based rub frequently. Get
